@@ -0,0 +1,60 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+depends_on:
+- 01M1MP01P7SV7C2S0S8QZ0A60T
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '9180'
+title: 'Interrupt: Ctrl-C sends session/cancel and exits 4'
+---
+### What
+
+cli-plan.md §5.9. `Ctrl-C` must not kill the process.
+
+In `Sources/acp-agent/InterruptHandler.swift`:
+
+1. Install a `SIGINT` source. Ignore the default disposition, so the
+   process does not die.
+2. On the first signal, send `session/cancel` over the connection, wait
+   for the `cancelled` stop reason, print the answer text that already
+   arrived, and exit 4.
+3. On the second signal, end the process at once.
+4. During a download, the first signal stops the resolution and exits 4.
+   A partly downloaded model stays in the Hugging Face cache, so the
+   next run continues rather than starting again — do not remove
+   anything on the way out.
+
+A signal handler must be async-signal-safe, so use a
+`DispatchSourceSignal` and do the real work on a normal task, not inside
+the handler.
+
+This matters most with `--out-of-process`, and in `acp-client`. A hard
+kill of the client leaves a model process that holds gigabytes.
+
+- [ ] The `SIGINT` source, and the ignored default disposition
+- [ ] The first signal: cancel, wait, print, exit 4
+- [ ] The second signal: end at once
+- [ ] The download case leaves the cache alone
+
+### Acceptance Criteria
+
+- [ ] A `SIGINT` during a turn gives exit 4, and the text that already
+      arrived is on stdout.
+- [ ] A second `SIGINT` ends the process without waiting.
+- [ ] A `SIGINT` during a resolution gives exit 4, and the partly
+      downloaded files stay in the cache.
+- [ ] The handler itself calls nothing that is not async-signal-safe.
+
+### Tests
+
+- [ ] `Tests/FoundationModelsACPAgentTests/InterruptTests.swift`: with
+      the scripted model set to a slow turn, the test spawns the built
+      binary, sends `SIGINT`, and asserts exit 4 and the partial text.
+- [ ] A second `SIGINT` test asserts the process ends inside a short
+      time limit.
+- [ ] A test asserts that a `session/cancel` message reached the agent
+      before the exit — the recording client proves the protocol path.
+- [ ] `swift test` passes.
+
+### Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
\ No newline at end of file

 assignees:

+comments:
+- actor: claude-code
+  id: 01m1xf5jzvvhna6qcr6qszxc7m
+  text: |
+    ### The Router cancellation question — answered: NO
+
+    `router.resolve(profile:reporting:)` does NOT honour Task cancellation.
+
+    Evidence, read at the pinned revision in
+    `.build/checkouts/FoundationModelsRouter`:
+
+    - `Sources/FoundationModelsRouter/Router.swift` holds zero occurrences of
+      `Task.checkCancellation()`, `Task.isCancelled` and
+      `withTaskCancellationHandler`.
+    - The same count is zero in every file of `Resolution/` (`JointFit`,
+      `LiveModelLoader`, `ModelLoader`, `PinnedDateTokenizerLoader`,
+      `ResolutionProgress`, `SlotResolution`), of `Sizing/` (`Footprint`,
+      `HostProfile`, `RepoMetadata`), of `Core/` and of `Concurrency/`
+      (`AsyncSemaphore`, `RaceGate`, `ResidentModelGates`,
+      `SerialAsyncChain`).
+    - Every cancellation check the package has is in `Session/`
+      (`RoutedSessionActorTurnExecution`, `RoutedSessionActorGeneration`,
+      `RoutedSessionActorCompaction`) and in `Hosting/ToolRun.swift` — the
+      turn path, not the resolve path.
+    - `AsyncSemaphore` is the single-flight gate of the resolve. It has no
+      cancellation handler, so a cancelled task that waits on it keeps
+      waiting.
+
+    A second and independent reason, in this repository: the resolve runs
+    inside `RoutedACPAgent.init`, which `AgentComposition.compose` awaits,
+    which `Run.perform(environment:into:)` awaits BEFORE `RunTurn.answer`
+    pairs the two transport ends. During a download there is no ACP
+    connection and no session, so `session/cancel` has no addressee. The
+    §5.9 first-signal path cannot even be spoken during a resolution.
+
+    ### What this card does about it
+
+    - The download case is dropped from this card. This card covers the
+      turn only: a `SIGINT` during a `session/prompt`.
+    - Card `^rescancl` ("Router: make resolve honour Task cancellation")
+      carries the download case. cli-plan.md §5.9 loses the download
+      paragraph in this card, and it returns when the Router card lands.
+  timestamp: 2026-09-07T08:18:47.419503+00:00
